en_us.item.power_net_tool.name: Cable Network Analysis Tool
en_us.item.power_net_tool.desc.0: Right-click cable to analyze the power net.
en_us.item.power_net_tool.desc.3: Links with mismatching network info (BUGGED!) are RED
en_us.item.power_net_tool.desc.4: Displays stats such as link and subscriber count
en_us.item.power_net_tool.desc.5: Proxies are connection points for multiblock links (e.g. 4 for substations)
en_us.item.power_net_tool.desc.6: Particles only spawn in a 20 block radius!

zh_cn.item.power_net_tool.name: 电缆网络分析工具
zh_cn.item.power_net_tool.desc.0: 右键电缆以分析电力网络。
zh_cn.item.power_net_tool.desc.1: 连接点（电缆、电线杆等）以黄色表示。
zh_cn.item.power_net_tool.desc.2: 订阅者（任何接收端）以蓝色表示。
zh_cn.item.power_net_tool.desc.3: 网络信息不匹配的连接点（故障！）以红色表示。
zh_cn.item.power_net_tool.desc.4: 显示连接点数量、订阅者数量等统计数据。
zh_cn.item.power_net_tool.desc.5: 代理是多方块连接的连接点（例如变电站有4个）。
zh_cn.item.power_net_tool.desc.6: 粒子只会在20格半径内生成！
